changePassword.title: Choose your password
changePassword.body: You signed in with a temporary password. Pick one only you know.
changePassword.bodyVoluntary: Enter your current password, then pick a new one only you know.

body.invite: Hi {{name}}. Choose a password only you know. Once it is saved, you are signed in.
body.reset: Hi {{name}}. Choose a new password only you know. Once it is saved, you are signed in and your other devices are signed out.

invalid.title: This link can no longer be used
invalid.body: This link has expired or has already been used. Ask your centre for a new one.

passwordsOff.title: Sign in with Google
passwordsOff.body: Your centre has turned off signing in with a password, so there is no password to set. Sign in with Google using your email address instead.

unavailable.title: The link could not be checked

errors.tooLong: A password can be at most 512 characters.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Welcome back.
login.failed: Could not sign in. Please try again.
login.googleFailed: Google sign-in did not work. Please try again.
login.invalidCredentials: That email and password do not match. Check for typos, or ask your teacher to reset your password.
login.googleFailedTitle: Couldn't sign you in with Google
login.otherHost: Go to the sign-in page of {{host}}
login.noMethod: No way to sign in is available right now. Ask the front desk or your centre's administrator.

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.body: Your teacher or the centre can reset it for you. You will get a temporary password and choose a new one when you sign in.
forgot.googleBody: You do not need a password. Use Continue with Google.
